I already have the image, so I'm turning it into the structured output now. The document is a Korean delivery note from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, dated 2026.11.02, with the reference numbers I need to capture.

The stamp sits over part of the table header, covering some of the "단위" and "박스" text, but the PCS and 44 values underneath are still legible. There is no receiving date, and the receiver's signature is in the 인수자 field. Quantity works out to 2,000 per box and 19 kg per box, which checks out.

verdict.summary_en: Korean-language delivery note DN-261102-986 dated 2026.11.02 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg against PO 4500318725. It covers one line: CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6, 88 000 PCS in 44 boxes, total weight 836 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. Remarks say handle with care. The receiver field carries a handwritten signature 'Yilmaz D.', and a red Hwaseong Memory company seal is stamped on the right. There are no corrections or strike-throughs.
observations: Red circular company stamp 'HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD' with a star overlaps the table header and the unit/box columns; it partly covers the 단위 and 박스 header text, but the values PCS and 44 are readable.
The stamp contains no date or number.
Handwritten signature 'Yilmaz D.' in the 인수자 (receiver) field; no receiving date is written next to it.
The document gives no unit price, PO line number or batch number.
The note's own figures are consistent: 88 000 pcs / 44 boxes = 2 000 per box, and 836 kg / 44 boxes = 19 kg per box.
No handwritten corrections or strike-throughs are visible.
